title: Forge worker terminal overlay revision
audience: CloudX implementers reviewing the closable worker terminal view

sections.title: Current revision: closable worker terminal overlay

claims.text: View worker opens a terminal overlay above the current Forge section. X dismisses only the view; reopening returns to the same terminal. Worker tabs and controls remain inside Forge.

evidence.excerpt: Keeps the current section while selecting a terminal worker; dismissing clears only terminal view state.
Displays the matching owned terminal inside a native dialog; the close button closes the dialog without a worker lifecycle action.

evidence.locator: opens, closes, and reopens the same worker above Issues without a lifecycle action
evidence.excerpt: Current section and worker session survive dismissal/reopening; no worker mutation hook is called.
Real xterm and socket are reused across close/reopen; background output remains visible.

claims.text: The native dialog manages focus. Escape remains terminal input while the terminal has focus; Escape from the close control dismisses the dialog and restores focus.

evidence.excerpt: Prevents native cancellation only when focus is inside the terminal container.
Native modal dialog handles focus containment, outside content inertness and return to the invoking control.
Cancel is preventable; preventing its default action keeps the dialog open.
Native browser checks deliver Escape/Tab to xterm and close with Escape from the close control.

claims.text: The revision passed 84 web and 231 server tests, typecheck, all workspace builds and 12 shipped-shell browser tests. Desktop/mobile fixtures verified terminal overlay behavior.

evidence.locator: focused-web; terminal-resize-regressions; final-typecheck; final-build; shipped-browser; overlay-browser-fixture
evidence.excerpt: Exact executed commands and hashes; separate web/server test counts and real native-dialog fixture scope.

claims.text: The previous directory-trust and recovery revision passed 2359 tests in 120 files, typecheck, all workspace builds and 12 shipped-shell browser tests.

evidence.excerpt: Exact commands, original log hashes and selected output. Two earlier timing failures and a passing 195-test focused rerun are recorded separately.

claims.text: Resizing an ended terminal preserves replay without stopping the server. Unexpected terminal command errors close only the affected WebSocket; descriptor-race suppression does not establish process exit.

evidence.excerpt: Known exits skip resize; exact ENOTTY/EBADF ioctl errors are ignored without setting exited; other failures rethrow.
Validates dimensions and resizes only while the terminal is not known closed.

evidence.locator: terminal WebSocket message and cleanup callbacks
evidence.excerpt: Contains write/resize exceptions and closes the socket with 1011; logs cleanup disposer failure.

evidence.locator: reopens and resizes a real PTY view after exit/stop without losing replay or stopping the server
evidence.excerpt: Reopens replay twice, invokes direct adapter and WebSocket resize, and verifies the socket remains open and HTTP responds.
231 regression tests passed in three files.

claims.text: The restarted preview passed overlay open/close/reopen with the worker still awaiting review. Its earlier terminal session was unavailable; the live check sent no worker resume or input.

evidence.excerpt: Both viewport reports show terminalAvailable=false, preserved focus/section, unchanged awaiting_review PR6 worker and production service. Actual xterm continuity is covered separately by the fixture and real PTY tests.

blocks.text: **View worker** opens the existing worker terminal above the current Forge section. **X** dismisses only the view; reopening returns to the same terminal. Worker tabs and controls remain inside Forge.
The native modal dialog manages focus. Escape stays with the terminal while it has focus; Escape from the close control dismisses the overlay and returns focus to its opener.

A terminal resize after exit no longer stops the server. Known closed-terminal resizes are ignored; exact descriptor-race handling does not mark the process stopped. Unexpected terminal command errors close only the affected socket.

This revision passed 84 focused web tests and 231 server tests. `npm run typecheck`, `npm run build` and 12 shipped-shell browser checks also passed. Desktop and mobile browser fixtures verified close/reopen, retained output and connection, focus and Escape/Tab input, without lifecycle commands, page errors or horizontal overflow.

The restarted preview passed overlay open/close/reopen checks while the issue worker stayed awaiting review. Its earlier terminal session was unavailable, so that live check did not exercise xterm continuity or send worker input. The production-component browser fixture and real PTY regressions cover terminal continuity separately.

The previous directory-trust and recovery revision passed 2,359 tests in 120 files and 12 shipped-shell browser checks. These remain previous-revision evidence; the overlay uses focused UI, server and browser checks.
